goals.title: Walk into the crater at Tycoon and watch the meteor scene
Fight the goblins in the meteor forest and name your character
Reach Galuf at the meteor site
Leave the forest back the way you came (the entry tile)
goals.note: Flag 306 (set by event 44) differs between the new-game state and the world checkpoint after leaving the forest.

goals.title: Set the party's jobs
Get everyone to level 5 on the way
goals.safety: Do not grind past what the next fight needs.

goals.title: Pirates' Hideout: Encounter Faris and commandeer the pirate ship.
Town of Tule: Obtain the canal key from Zok.
Wind Shrine: Defeat the Wing Raptor, witness the Wind Crystal shatter, and unlock the first job classes.
Torna Canal: Defeat Karlabos; Syldra is pulled into the whirlpool.
Ship Graveyard: Navigate the sunken wreckage and defeat Siren.
Town of Carwen & North Mountain: Ascend the peak, defeat Magissa and Forza, and acquire the Hiryu (Wind Drake).
Castle & Town of Walse: Speak with King Walse regarding the Water Crystal.
Walse Tower: Climb the tower to confront Garula; the Water Crystal shatters.
Walse Meteorite: Enter the warp point to travel to the Karnak region.
Town & Castle of Karnak: Jailed upon arrival; break out alongside Cid.
Fire-Powered Ship: Traverse the boiler rooms and defeat Liquid Flame.
Castle Karnak (Escape): Complete the 10-minute timed escape as the Fire Crystal and castle explode.
Library of the Ancients: Defeat Ifrit and Byblos to rescue Mid and restore the Fire-Powered Ship.
Town of Crescent & Black Chocobo Forest: Lose the ship to a whirlpool, find the Black Chocobo, and gain flight.
Desert of Shifting Sands: Defeat the Sandworm and traverse the sand currents.
Gohn (Town of Ruin): Track King Tycoon into the underground passages; the Earth Crystal site rises into the sky.
Crescent Island Catapult: Upgrade the ship into a flying airship.
Ronka Meteorites (Tycoon, Walse, Karnak, Gohn): Defeat the Adamantoise and charge the airship for high-altitude flight.
Flying Ronka Ruins: Destroy the fortress turrets, scale the ruins, defeat Archeoaevis, and witness the release of Exdeath.
Tycoon Meteorite: Return to activate the warp gate to Galuf's world.
Solitary Island & Castle Exdeath (Dungeon): Party is captured; Galuf infiltrates the castle solo to rescue them.
Big Bridge: Battle across the bridge and defeat Gilgamesh before the barrier repels the party.
Town of Regole: Rest and resupply in the southern territory.
Kuza, the Sealed Castle: Pass through the hall housing the 12 Legendary Weapons.
Underground Waterway & Moogle Village: Escort a stranded Moogle through subterranean tunnels to reach its village.
Castle of Bal: Rejoin Galuf's soldiers and gain access to the kingdom.
Town of Quelb: Pass through the werewolf settlement after meeting Kelger.
Drakenvale (Valley of Dragons): Ascend the mountain to retrieve Dragon Grass to heal Bal's dying Wind Drake.
Surgate Castle & Zeza's Fleet: Coordinate with King Zeza aboard his flagship to stage an assault on Exdeath's barrier.
Barrier Tower: Scale the tower and defeat Atomos to disable the barrier shielding Castle Exdeath.
Submarine Trenches & Ghido's Cave: Navigate underwater passages to consult Sage Ghido.
Town of Moore & Great Forest of Moore: Burn through the forest using the Elder Tree branch, defeat the Crystal Guardians, and witness Galuf's final stand against Exdeath.
Castle Exdeath: Dispel the illusion via Kelger's sacrifice, climb to the summit, defeat Gilgamesh, and defeat Exdeath.
Castle Tycoon: Celebrate after returning, right before the castle is swallowed by the Void.
Antlion's Den: Rescue Faris and Boko from the cavern sinkhole.
Pyramid of Moore: Navigate ancient traps and defeat Gargoyles to retrieve the **First Tablet**.
Guardian Tree (Forest of Moore): Confront Exdeath, watch Tycoon disappear, and obtain the combined airship/submarine.
Kuza, the Sealed Castle: Exchange the First Tablet to unseal the first 3 Legendary Weapons.
Island Shrine: Scale the air ducts to obtain the **Second Tablet** and unlock Syldra.
Fork Tower: Split into physical (Minotaur) and magic (Omniscient) teams to dispel the barrier guarding Flare and Holy.
Great Sea Trench: Dive underwater with the submarine to claim the **Third Tablet** and Meteor.
Istory Falls: Navigate the subterranean waterfall to claim the **Fourth Tablet** and Leviathan.
Kuza, the Sealed Castle: Return to unseal the remaining 9 Legendary Weapons.
